Class ModuleRegistry

dev.px.core.registry.Registry<Module>
dev.px.core.module.ModuleRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Module>
public final class ModuleRegistry extends Registry<Module>
Every module in the client.

Registration does three things a caller used to have to remember: it resolves the module's Category against the CategoryRegistry, subscribes the module to the event bus for good, and fails loudly on a bad category name instead of leaving the module orphaned in the GUI.

Lookup, iteration and sorting come from Registry; only the module-specific parts live here.

    • applyDefaults

      public void applyDefaults()
      Switches on every module whose ModuleInfo.enabled() is true.

      Called once by Core after all services are up, not during registration, so a default-on module's onEnable sees a fully built client. A config load afterwards overrides whatever this set.
